name: desktop-buddy
description: A chibi Labrador desktop buddy that walks along the bottom of your screens, watches your active window, naps when you're idle, and delivers alerts and guidance.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.sprites: node scripts/gen-lab-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-robot-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-unicorn-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-rainbowman-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-labdoc-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-skeleton-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-pumpkin-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-duckling-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-rubberduck-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-capybara-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-josie-sprites.mjs && node scripts/gen-dna-sprites.mjs && node scripts/make-example-bundle.mjs
scripts.update: git pull && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && node bin/buddy.js service restart

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Desktop Buddy reads the frontmost window position so your buddy can walk over and watch it.
